description: Source code for the radio_zmq_tx_stream class, implementing ZeroMQ transmission stream with channel management, alignment, and data transmission functionalities.

classes.name: radio_zmq_tx_stream
classes.description: Manages ZeroMQ transmission channels, handles data alignment, and transmits baseband data streams.

methods.name: radio_zmq_tx_stream::radio_zmq_tx_stream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the transmission stream with context, configuration, executor, and notifier.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts all channels with an initial timestamp.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Aligns channels to a given timestamp within a timeout, returns true if at least one channel is in the past.

methods.name: transmit
methods.description: Transmits baseband data after aligning stream and handling late timestamp notifications.
